notes.title: Seclusion: Islesbury Soundtrack News
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30455517/59726583e822e1f5e855c58b8a4e2c3a7ee44856.png[/img]

Seclusion: Islesbury is nearing its completion as the days pass and today it's time to share some samples from our soundtrack. 

Created by [url=https://twitter.com/NicoNegronMusic]Nico Negron[/url], Seclusion: Islesbury soundtrack is dark, cold, and mysterious to perfectly fit into the town itself.

If you want to know what Islesbury sounds like listen to these amazing tunes!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ug8m6TWk-H8
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Eg8mogPvas4
